## Books · the spine of the course

| Role | Resource | Why |
|------|----------|-----|
| **Primary textbook** | [Prince, *Understanding Deep Learning* (2023)](https://udlbook.github.io/udlbook/) | Free PDF, CC-BY figures, modern coverage |
| **Rigour supplement** | Bishop & Bishop, *Deep Learning: Foundations and Concepts* (2024) | Math-first, careful derivations |
| **Hands-on labs** | [Zhang et al., *Dive into Deep Learning*](https://d2l.ai) | PyTorch code for every chapter |
| **Practical engineering** | [Chip Huyen, *AI Engineering* (2024)](https://huyenchip.com/) | LLM productionization, inference |
| **Classical reference** | Goodfellow, Bengio, Courville, *Deep Learning* (2016) | The bibliography canon |

---

## Video courses · pick one and watch start-to-finish

| Course | Best for | Length |
|--------|----------|--------|
| **Karpathy · *Zero to Hero*** | the *foundations* track — micrograd → MLP → Transformer → tokenizer | ~10 hrs |
| **CS231n (Stanford)** | CNN / vision deep dive — maps almost 1-1 onto L01-L09 | ~12 hrs |
| **CS224N (Manning, Stanford)** | sequences → attention → transformers → LLMs — covers L10-L16 | ~15 hrs |
| **MIT 6.S191** | gentle intro alternative to CS231n | ~10 hrs |
| **Andrew Ng · Deep Learning Specialization** | gentlest pace, classic intuition | ~30 hrs (5 courses) |
| **Fast.ai · Practical Deep Learning** | code-first, transfer-learning emphasis | ~20 hrs |

## Preparation runbook for the instructor

A first-time-teaching survival plan, condensed ·

### 4 weeks before semester

- **Week 1** · read UDL Ch 1–7 end-to-end · skim formulas, focus on figures.
- **Week 2** · watch **CS231n** L1–9 (Karpathy/Johnson) · ~12 hrs.
- **Week 3** · watch **Karpathy *Zero to Hero*** playlist · ~10 hrs.
- **Week 4** · watch **CS224N** L1–10 (Manning) · ~15 hrs.

### 1 week before each lecture

1. Read your own deck cold (45 min). Note any slide you can't explain in 30 sec.
2. Walk every worked numeric on paper (15 min).
3. Play with the linked interactive (10 min) — be the student.
4. Pick 2 students to call on. Decide your skip list from the ⭐⭐⭐ optional slides.

### Day of lecture

- Marp presenter mode + notebook + interactive in three windows.
- Write opening sentence on paper. One sentence.
- 75-min timer. 5 min for Q&A.
